faqs.question: What services does AptenTech offer?
faqs.answer: We cover SEO, AI visibility, search engine marketing (SEM), paid social, content, link building, CRO, email marketing services, lead generation services, reputation management, and web development. Most clients start with three or four channels and expand once the results justify it.

faqs.question: How much does digital marketing cost?
faqs.answer: Most US agencies charge a management retainer plus a separate media budget, typically between $2,500 and $12,000 a month depending on how many channels you run. Your ad spend stays in accounts you own. We will tell you honestly whether your target is reachable at your budget.

faqs.question: How long before we see results?
faqs.answer: Paid channels give readable data within four to six weeks. SEO and AI visibility take three to six months to move and longer to compound. Any top digital marketing company that promises page one in thirty days is not being straight with you.

faqs.question: Do you work with clients outside your city?
faqs.answer: Almost all of our work is remote. If you have been searching for a digital marketing agency near me, the better question is who does the work and how they report on it, not how far away they sit. Local knowledge comes from research, not proximity.

faqs.question: Do you require a long-term contract?
faqs.answer: Three months to start, then month to month with notice. Three months is roughly the minimum window to judge the work fairly, and it protects both sides from drawing conclusions off one bad month.

faqs.question: Who owns the accounts and data?
faqs.answer: You do, from day one. Ad accounts, analytics, tag containers, dashboards, content, and creative are all set up in your name. If you leave, you keep everything and we remove our access.

faqs.question: Can you work alongside our in-house team?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it often works best that way. We can lead the whole program or fill specific gaps. Analytics, paid media, technical SEO, and development are what teams ask us for most.

faqs.question: What makes you different from other agencies?
faqs.answer: We have engineers on staff. Most agencies audit your site, find the problems, then hand the fixes back to your developers. A top digital marketing company should be able to build what it recommends, and that is what we do.

faqs.question: How to choose a digital marketing company?
faqs.answer: Choose a digital marketing company with proven results, relevant industry experience, transparent pricing, clear communication, customized strategies, and measurable reporting.
